headline: Indonesia U-17 Qualifies For 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup After Victory
seoTitle: Indonesia U-17 Qualifies For 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup
metaDescription: The Indonesia U-17 national team secured a spot in the 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup after defeating Afghanistan 4-0 in their final qualifying match.
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia U-17 defeated Afghanistan 4-0 to finish as Group A winners in the 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup qualifiers.
The victory ensured the team earned nine points across three matches with a clean sheet record.
Head coach David Nascimento criticized the team's mental approach despite the decisive win.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesia U-17 national football team successfully qualified for the final round of the 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup after achieving a dominant 4-0 victory over Afghanistan. Competing in Group A, the squad maintained a perfect record throughout the qualifying phase, securing nine points from three matches without conceding any goals. Following the match, PSSI Chairman Erick Thohir expressed pride in the team's achievement, noting that four Indonesian national squads have now qualified for their respective Asian Cup tournaments. Despite the lopsided scoreline, head coach David Nascimento voiced concerns regarding the players' mental state during the game, urging for improvements. Players attributed the successful campaign to rigorous physical training regimens implemented over several months and specific tactical instructions provided by the coaching staff leading up to the tournament decider at Thuwunna Stadium.
